items.title: Bumper debut! ESDS Software shares list at 76% premium over IPO price
items.description: ESDS Software's share price listed at ₹757 apiece on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) as against the offer price of ₹429, a premium of 76.46 per cent.

items.title: September IPO pipeline set to eclipse July's record fundraising milestone
items.description: Market participants attribute the primary market's momentum to the Sebi's regulatory nod for the National Stock Exchange's public issue, laying the groundwork for a mega-listing.
